messages:
matt: Heads-up — telemetry showing a spike in decode errors for runtime-3.2 on canary with quant-v4b longseq workloads. Failure rate ~2.8% over last 10m, up from 0.1%.

sara: thanks — is this the `kv-cache` regression we saw last week or something new? any logs?

matt: looks different. stack trace indicates `memcheck` OOM on certain attention kernels. snippet: `E/Runtime: kv_cache_alloc failed: -12` from gpu0.

oliver: hmm, we pushed the SDK 2.9.1 shim yesterday — could be an ABI mismatch between runtime-3.2 and the new client zero-copy path.

carla: QA started a smoke run against canary 20m ago and their longseq test shows token drops too. failing prompt: `> summarize-long-doc --max-tokens 12000` — reproducer attached in thread.

deploybot: Deploybot: Canaries for runtime-3.2 (pool: canary-eu) are at 60% of traffic. Pinlist: none. Scheduled unpin window opens in 30m unless a hold is requested.

matt: propose a conditional hold: pause the unpin for canary-eu and run a hotpatch that tweaks allocator thresholds. low-risk change, quick rollback.

sara: +1 on hold. we should also check SDK 2.9.1 fallback path. if the hotpatch doesn't land, fallback is to pin the runtime back to 3.1 on the affected pool.

oliver: I ran a quick diff between the shim ABI and the runtime symbols — there are two new symbols `zero_copy_map` and `zc_release` that runtime-3.2 expects when built with SDK 2.9.x. If hotpatch can't be done in 20m, pinback to 3.1 is safest.

carla: QA: can run 3 smoke lanes in parallel; need ~12m to validate hotpatch. will report mem and token error counts.

release-manager: Action: block the scheduled unpin for canary-eu now. @deploybot please set hold with tag `#conditional-hotpatch`.

deploybot: Deploybot: Hold applied by release-manager. unpin window canceled for canary-eu.

matt: creating PR for allocator tweak: `r/inference#4821` — small patch to increase spare slab by 8MB and add retry on `kv_cache_alloc`. cc @oliver @carla

oliver: skimmed the PR — looks okay. two inline nits in comments, but nothing blocking.

carla: QA started run against `matt/hotpatch/allocator-4821`. preliminary: token drop rate dropped to 0.05%, mem OOMs not observed in 15m.

sara: good signal. we should also land a temporary SDK compatibility lint in CI to catch the missing symbols before runtime rollouts.

oliver: I'll open a follow-up CI PR after this lands. low-priority but useful.

release-manager: Plan: 1) land hotpatch to canary-eu, roll for 30m, QA validates. 2) if green, proceed with global unpin tomorrow during change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. 3) if regressions, pinback to 3.1 and raise incident.

matt: landing hotpatch to canary-eu now — rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 12m. will annotate with `#hotpatch-allocator-4821`.

deploybot: Deploybot: Rollout started for `runtime-3.2-hotpatch-4821` (canary-eu). 10% -> 50% scheduled.

qa-bot: QA-bot: smoke lane complete — no regressions on longseq, token error rate 0.03% (baseline 0.02%).

carla: running extended 60m soak now, will ping in 45m with final numbers.

sara: thumbs — if soak stays stable let's merge and update the release notes with the mitigations and the SDK compatibility reminder.

matt: noted for release notes: "hotpatch: increased kv_cache spare slab to reduce OOMs on quantized longseq; added allocation retry path; pinned SDK compatibility lint added to CI". will draft.

release-manager: After merge, we still hold the unpin until morning change window. @matt @sara please coordinate release notes + postmortem if needed.

matt: will post a brief runbook in `/docs/runbooks/hotpatch-allocator.md` and link in release notes.

carla: final soak update: 60m stable, token error rate 0.02%, mem OOMs 0. No other abnormalities.

sara: OK — approving forward plan. we'll resume unpin tomorrow in change window. :thumbsup:

oliver: follow-up: I'll add a CI check to warn when runtime symbols and SDK shims diverge.

deploybot: Deploybot: Hold tag `#conditional-hotpatch` will be auto-removed tomorrow 02:10 UTC if not manually cleared.

matt: thanks all — great cross-team response. closing thread once PR merged and notes published.

sara: thanks! :rocket:

deploybot: Deploybot: PR `r/inference#4821` merged by matt. Rollout completed to canary-eu. Hold remains until change window.
